### [Quoting Anthropic Frontier Red Team](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/29/anthropic-frontier-red-team/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-09-29

Anthropic's Frontier Red Team reported that GLM-5.3 and Claude Mythos Preview achieved full control flow hijacks in an internal Binary Exploitation benchmark, whereas prior generation models completely failed.

- GLM-5.3 achieved full control flow hijacks in 4% of trials on a random sample of 100 internal Binary Exploitation benchmark tasks.
- Claude Mythos Preview achieved full control flow hijacks in 6% of the same benchmark trials.
- Previous generation models, specifically Claude Opus 4.6 and GLM-5.2, achieved a 0% success rate on these tasks.

**Why it matters:** The findings demonstrate a qualitative shift in AI capabilities, as newer models have crossed a threshold into executing functional, complex cyber exploitation tasks.
